name: documentation-ai-migration
description: Migrate a documentation site onto Documentation.AI exactly: Mintlify, GitBook, ReadMe, Document360, MadCap Flare and generic sources; deliver through your own clone, a git remote, or the Authoring MCP server with a browser sign-in; verification and a plain-language report.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate a documentation site onto Documentation.AI, exactly, with a preview first
interface.longDescription: Discovers, converts, verifies and reports a documentation migration from Mintlify, GitBook, ReadMe, Document360, MadCap Flare or any Markdown or live site into Documentation.AI. A deterministic command line does the converting; the assistant runs it and stops at four decisions a person makes. Deliver through your own clone, a git remote, or the Authoring MCP server with a browser sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Use $migrate to migrate a documentation site onto Documentation.AI: ask me for the source, how to deliver it, the template and a workspace folder, then run the four-gate workflow.
